name: Roshani Mvula-Atencio
location: Bay View Docks, temporary berth at Pier 14-Gamma (airship caravan The Abundant Error), near Michigan Ave South and Cermak
description:
Roshani is solid and practical in the way of people who lift and carry things every day — not large but dense with muscle, with the sun-damaged skin of someone who spends significant time on open airship decks and the quick, evaluating eyes of a born trader. Her hair is streaked in color-shifting strands, currently cycling through amber and deep red with the temperature, a mod she wears for professional reasons: 'People remember the hair,' she explains without embarrassment. She has a pattern of scarification on her left forearm in a Zambian geometric style, done by her mother, which she occasionally traces with her thumb when calculating.

Roshani runs textiles, preserved food, hand-fabricated tools, and 'specialty information' (she is vague about this category) between the transit hubs and fringe communities around GLMZ's industrial periphery. She is a member of a caravan of six airships called The Abundant Error, which operates on informal routes that avoid Ferrogate Transit's official freight lanes and the associated fees. She is sharp, cheerful, aggressively fair in her dealings, and completely at home in ambiguity — she has been in seventeen border disputes, four quarantine zones, and one civil emergency, and approaches all of them with the same businesslike equanimity.

core_fears: The caravan dissolving — her community scattered
Being cheated in a way she didn't see coming, which she reads as a failure of perception
core_desires: To negotiate a deal so elegant that both parties feel they won
To eventually own her own ship outright
coping_mechanisms: Treats every problem as a transaction — finds the exchange rate for any situation
Cooking for the caravan crew when stressed
blind_spots: Applies market logic to situations that aren't transactional — reads emotional needs as negotiating positions
Underestimates loyalty that isn't expressed in practical action
psychology.secret: The 'specialty information' she trades occasionally includes the locations of Q-zero communities — not to corponations, she tells herself, only to other drifters who need to find them. She knows this is not entirely safe and has not fully examined whether it is ethical.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Trade-precise, good with numbers, switches between formal and colloquial seamlessly depending on who she's reading as her market. Occasional Nyanja words when doing mental arithmetic.
speech_patterns.cadence: Brisk and rhythmic, like someone who has made the same pitch many times and refined every syllable
verbal_tics: 'Fairly said' to acknowledge a point without conceding
'What's the exchange?' when presented with any request
example_lines: 'Fairly said, but that price assumes I have no other buyers today, and I have three. What's the exchange?'
'I don't carry things I can't account for. You want passage with no manifest? What's that worth to you, specifically, in numbers?'

story_hooks: Roshani has sold location information about a Q-zero community that was subsequently raided — she doesn't know yet, but the information chain is traceable back to her
The Abundant Error has taken on a cargo container that no one on the crew can open, consigned by a shipper who has since disappeared from all records
narrative_function: Trade hub and mobile resource — she can source unusual goods, carries messages between communities, knows prices and conditions across the entire drifter trade network, and can offer passage on The Abundant Error to characters who need to move without official transit records.
augmentations: Color-shifting hair mod (temperature-reactive, amber to red spectrum). Enhanced olfactory glands — helps assess food quality and cargo condition. No chrome.
daily_life: Rises with the dock schedule, negotiates with dock officials and suppliers through the morning, spends afternoons managing cargo manifests and caravan logistics, evenings trading social currency — information, introductions, gossip — in whatever gathering the docks offer.
affiliation: The Abundant Error airship caravan (six vessels, rotating crew of about thirty total)

decision_rules: Never carry cargo that could get the caravan grounded permanently
Every favor has a price — establishing this clearly is a kindness, not a cruelty
escalation_ladder: Recalculates and offers a revised terms
Brings in caravan members as witness-witnesses to a dispute
Leaves the transaction entirely and blacklists the counterparty across her network

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Assesses purchasing power and information value immediately; warm but professionally so
interpersonal_modes.friends: Absurdly generous — keeps exact mental track of every favor and reciprocates with interest, considers this love

stress_responses.low: Starts mentally repricing everything around her
stress_responses.medium: Cooks something elaborate for the crew without explanation
stress_responses.high: Calls a full caravan meeting and tables everything for group decision — distributed stress

contradictions: Deeply communal in practice while intellectually committed to individual transaction logic
habits: Traces the scarification on her forearm when calculating
Tastes cargo food samples before any deal closes
Keeps a running ledger of favors given and owed in a physical notebook
breaking_points: Someone threatening the caravan's ability to fly
Being betrayed by someone she vouched for to the group

timeline.event: Born aboard a freight airship in the Gulf Shelf corridor to a Zambian-Bolivian trader family
Joined The Abundant Error caravan as a junior cargo hand
Became primary trade negotiator for the caravan after previous trader retired
First began trading 'specialty information' including drifter community locations
Currently docked at Bay View Docks for a three-day resupply run

related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Containment Foam Launcher CFL-2 'Amber'
Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'

physical_description.heritage: Southern African (Zambian) / Latin American (Atencio suggests Spanish/Portuguese lineage)
physical_description.build: Compact and densely muscled, shoulders and forearms developed from years of loading/unloading cargo. No excess fat. Functional rather than aesthetic physique.
physical_description.hair_color: Thermochromic — shifts between amber and deep red depending on ambient temperature; base tone appears dark brown underneath
physical_description.hair_style: Worn in a practical high braid during work hours, loose when off-duty. Deliberately styled to catch light and memory.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with visible pattern recognition — quick, calculating gaze
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-warm brown with significant sun damage across shoulders, forearms, and face from chronic deck exposure
physical_description.complexion: Weather-worn and frank. Sun spots across nose and cheekbones. No cosmetics typically worn. Hands calloused, nails short and functional.
distinguishing_marks: Zambian geometric scarification pattern on left forearm — parallel lines and interlocking chevrons, faded to pale brown, done in traditional style by her mother
Sun-bleached patches on temples and upper chest from repeated UV exposure
Small burn scar on right palm (cargo accident, several years old)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible to standard observation. Color-shifting hair appears cosmetic but is thermochromic biotech. Enhanced olfactory glands are internal — no external indicator except occasional deliberate sniffing behavior when assessing cargo.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical efficiency — no wasted motion. Often stands with weight shifted to one side, thumb tracing left forearm scar when thinking or calculating prices. Handshake is firm and deliberate. Eyes constantly evaluate surroundings and people.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical wear: reinforced cargo pants in neutral gray or earth tones (Shimano Logistics or Aerodyne brands), sleeveless or short-sleeved work shirts (often pale linen for heat management), worn leather work vest with multiple pockets and patch repairs. Steel-toed boots, scuffed and practical. Minimal jewelry except for a thin bracelet made from woven synthetic cord — a caravan marker. Functional rather than fashionable; clothes chosen for durability and utility over status.
